mentions.name: MomentFrame
mentions.description: iOS app that turns photos into Polaroid-style prints, automatically filling in the location and date/time from the photo's metadata. Captions can be edited and the crop adjusted, then the result exported or shared. Everything runs on-device with no account, tracking, or uploads. The first 5 photos are free, and a one-time $1.99 purchase unlocks unlimited exports.
mentions.problem: The author needed a simple way to caption the important moments of life with the when and where, initially to create a personal gift tracking the family's journey together.
